requirements.heading: The Content-Disposition Header Field
requirements.text: quoted-date-time := quoted-string ; contents MUST be an RFC 822 `date-time' ; numeric timezones (+HHMM or -HHMM) MUST be used

requirements.heading: The Content-Disposition Header Field
requirements.text: NOTE ON PARAMETER VALUE LENGHTS: A short (length <= 78 characters) parameter value containing only non-`tspecials' characters SHOULD be represented as a single `token'.

requirements.heading: The Content-Disposition Header Field
requirements.text: A short parameter value containing only ASCII characters, but including `tspecials' characters, SHOULD be represented as `quoted-string'.

requirements.heading: The Content-Disposition Header Field
requirements.text: Parameter values longer than 78 characters, or which contain non-ASCII characters, MUST be encoded as specified in [RFC 2184].

requirements.heading: The Filename Parameter
requirements.text: The suggested filename SHOULD be checked (and possibly changed) to see that it conforms to local filesystem conventions, does not overwrite an existing file, and does not present a security problem (see Security Considerations below).

requirements.heading: The Filename Parameter
requirements.text: The receiving MUA SHOULD NOT respect any directory path information that may seem to be present in the filename parameter.

requirements.heading: The Creation-Date parameter
requirements.text: The creation-date parameter MAY be used to indicate the date at which the file was created.

requirements.heading: The Creation-Date parameter
requirements.text: If this parameter is included, the paramter value MUST be a quoted-string which contains a representation of the creation date of the file in [RFC 822] `date-time' format.

requirements.heading: The Modification-Date parameter
requirements.text: The modification-date parameter MAY be used to indicate the date at which the file was last modified.

requirements.heading: The Modification-Date parameter
requirements.text: If the modification-date parameter is included, the paramter value MUST be a quoted-string which contains a representation of the last modification date of the file in [RFC 822] `date-time' format.

requirements.heading: The Read-Date parameter
requirements.text: The read-date parameter MAY be used to indicate the date at which the file was last read.

requirements.heading: The Read-Date parameter
requirements.text: If the read-date parameter is included, the parameter value MUST be a quoted-string which contains a representation of the last-read date of the file in [RFC 822] `date- time' format.
